sciencedaily.headline: Scientists discover reversible male birth control that stops sperm production
sciencedaily.summary: Cornell University scientists have developed a reversible, nonhormonal male contraceptive that temporarily halts sperm production by disrupting meiosis. In a mouse study, treatment with compound JQ1 completely stopped sperm production for three weeks, with fertility returning within six weeks after treatment ended and producing healthy offspring.
